youtube.title: Why Bricks Have Holes Through Them 🧱 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Many bricks are made with holes or cores on purpose. Thick solid clay dries and bakes unevenly, which can crack it, while holes let heat and steam reach the middle so the brick fires evenly. The holes also make bricks lighter and cheaper to make and lay, and the trapped air helps insulate the wall.
